description: §6.6.9 exclusion (RULING A) — reading server-side identity in a server fn is NOT E-REACTIVE-003: `@currentUser` (§52.15.1, lowers to the server-resolved `_scrml_currentUser`, never `_scrml_body`) and the §20.5 server `session` object (`session.userId`, bound from the session middleware). The raw client value `@price` is passed as an explicit param `p` (escape hatch), keeping the whole fn clean. MIGRATED S449 (ruling item 1): this case used to read `${@session.userId}` and certified an emit that took the id from the CLIENT request body (`_scrml_body["session"].userId`); a server `@session` read is now E-SESSION-AMBIENT-SERVER, so it reads `session.userId`. Its bare `<program … auth>` (no value) is now E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID (ruling item 4), so it declares `auth="required"`. That the emitted server reads the server session (and a spoofed body cannot change the id written) is asserted over HTTP by the source-test. Incidental auth/SQL warnings ignored by superset.
rationale: §6.6.9 exclusions: the ambient identity singletons are not client cells and never trigger E-REACTIVE-003; '`@session` is server-only identity and SHALL NEVER be marshalled from the client'. §20.5: `session` is the server-side accessor. Ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S449 items 1 and 4.
